title: HIGH-TENSION CORDS AND CORD CLAMPS REMOVAL
ocr_text:
IG-10
IGNITION SYSTEM – (2JZ-GE)

5mm Hexagon Wrench

HIGH-TENSION CORDS AND CORD CLAMPS REMOVAL
1. REMOVE THROTTLE BODY
(See throttle body removal in SFI System)
2. REMOVE NO.3 TIMING BELT COVER
(a) Remove the oil filler cap.
(b) Using a 5 mm hexagon wrench, remove the 6 bolts and timing belt cover.

5 mm
Hexagen
Wrench

3. REMOVE CYLINDER HEAD REAR COVER
Using a 5 mm hexagon wrench, remove the 4 bolts and rear cover.

4. REMOVE HIGH-TENSION CORDS AND CORD CLAMPS ASSEMBLY
(a) Disconnect the 2 high-tension cord clamps from the claws of the No.3 cylinder head cover.
(b) Remove the bolt holding the high-tension cord clamp to No.2 cylinder head cover.

Pry
Pull

(c) Disconnect the high-tension cords from the distributor and ignition coil.
• Using a screwdriver, lift up the lock claw and disconnect the holder from the distributor (ignition coil).

WRONG
CORRECT

• Disconnect the high-tension cord at the grommet. Do not pull on the cord.
NOTICE: Pulling on or bending the cords may damage the conductor inside.
